summary: The Python SDK pins protobuf to versions below 7, preventing users from upgrading. Attempts to support protobuf 7 are blocked by grpcio-tools, which also constrains protobuf to <7 even in its latest release.
userImpact: Users cannot upgrade to protobuf 7 due to SDK version constraints and transitive dependency conflicts with grpcio-tools.
rootCause: Both the SDK and grpcio-tools maintain constraints pinning protobuf to <7, and grpcio-tools has not released a version supporting protobuf 7 as of the latest stable release (1.81.0).
proposedFix: Update the SDK's protobuf constraint to allow version 7, ensure compatibility, and potentially coordinate with grpcio-tools maintainers.
keyQuote: grpcio-tools also depends on protobuf and still pins it to <7, even in its latest stable release (1.81.0), which causes a dependency conflict
